## Uptime watcher
The schedule fires every 10 minutes.
List Watched URLs emits one item per URL. The default list is https://example.com/ and https://example.org/.
Fetch Watched URL performs the HTTP check and keeps non-2xx responses as data.
Update Check State stores consecutiveFailures and status in workflow static data.
Send Down Alert and Send Recovery Notice use the Send Email node. Attach an SMTP credential in the n8n UI.
Set WORKFLOWKIT_FROM and WORKFLOWKIT_TO in the n8n environment before activating.

## Two failures, then one alert
Failure 1: status degraded, no alert.
Failure 2: status down, send one down alert.
Further failures stay down and do not send another alert.
The next success after status down sends a recovery email and sets status up.
